STOP→EmergencyStop · latch armed · heater off + fan 100% · stop_streaming · roast_logger::stop_roast

OFF by default · allowed while latched · #OK · START/OT1/OT2 no longer enable it · is_continuous_enabled gate
dump_pending.clear · roast_logger::dump (tail preserved) · split on \n · cap LOG_CAPACITY+1 · 128 B rows

svg.text: Top to bottom = time order. Each card = one step with its exact file and function. Loop D (steps 13–21) repeats ~3×/s for the whole roast.
Safety: any trip in D lands in LATCH (ERR safety_fault, SSR 0 + fan 100%). Canonical recovery: PID;OFF (no bare OFF exists on the wire).
Sources verified: main.rs · app_builder.rs · tasks.rs · roaster_control.rs · parser.rs · multiplexer.rs · transport_tasks.rs · artisan.rs · roast_logger.rs · watchdog.rs · ssr_logic.rs
